features: indoor pan/tilt camera, remotely controllable head (288 deg pan / 120 deg tilt)
first INSTAR camera with the new VGA chipset
8 x 850nm infrared LEDs, indoor night-vision range approx 5-8m; IR light can be switched off manually to avoid window reflections
2-way audio via integrated microphone and speaker (usable as baby/pet monitor)
alarm I/O for external sensors (e.g. motion or smoke detectors) and receivers (e.g. home automation)
email alarm notification with 4-6 snapshot images attached
FTP upload support (use as a webcam), free integrated INSTAR DDNS address for remote access
detachable wall mount with a standard 1/4-inch tripod thread

home_assistant.notes: Legacy VGA generation - MJPEG/JPEG over HTTP web interface; no ONVIF/RTSP. Use the generic camera integration.

blue_iris.notes: Legacy INSTAR VGA camera - HTTP/MJPEG only; not independently confirmed for this specific model.
